searchText: Have we tried an updated slasher in any of devnets yet? This is to ensure that slashing flow works correctly with EIP-7549 attestation format Yeah we have a slashing test and its part of the validator lifecycle tests. cc <@808969530608451584> for crosschecking if its being run on devnet-6 nimbusel bug yea, there are multiple slashings involved in our tests. but these are specially crafted slashings, so we're not really testing the slasher that way as the slashable conditions were never on chain (no double attestation or so). We should probably just run a key twice and see if a running slasher still detects it 🙂 yes, please, do. testing slasher itself is also important Hey, I've checked all the outstanding issues in the [hive results](https://sk3.taile8f668.ts.net/#summary-sort=name&group-by=client) for devnet-6: - Geth/Besu: Timeout due to RLP block importing, we could workaround by `--client.checktimelimit=120s` - **Not blocking for devnet-6** - Erigon, Engine API incorrect error when delivering incorrect requests in new payload - **Maybe blocking for devnet-6** - Nethermind: - Potential consensus issue if the EIP-2935 system contract is not deployed at fork - **Blocking for devnet-6 if the system contract is not deployed at fork** - Same issue as Erigon: Getting invalid block instead of Engine API error - **Maybe blocking for devnet-6** - Reth: Consensus issue on EIP-7702 test (gas usage) - **Not blocking for devnet-6** I've noticed geth nodes returning this error when trying to send 7702 transactions to them via rpc (submit signed tx): `transaction type not supported: received type 4` sure you're on the fork from s1na? Yea, and just to double check: It's the same when sending eip7702 tx to our geth nodes 😉 ^ <@259648573401071617> Yes the 7702 txpool PR is still open and pending. Will update here when it is merged reth issue is not blocking because it's unrealistic to hit that and something we've confirmed we won't fix because of how expensive the check is for us got it, yes I thought this was some other case, I think it's fair, it would require a very expensive hash collision

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content: Have we tried an updated slasher in any of devnets yet? This is to ensure that slashing flow works correctly with EIP-7549 attestation format

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content: Yeah we have a slashing test and its part of the validator lifecycle tests. cc <@808969530608451584> for crosschecking if its being run on devnet-6

excerpts.author: pk910
excerpts.content:
yea, there are multiple slashings involved in our tests.
but these are specially crafted slashings, so we're not really testing the slasher that way as the slashable conditions were never on chain  (no double attestation or so).
We should probably just run a key twice and see if a running slasher still detects it 🙂

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content: yes, please, do. testing slasher itself is also important

excerpts.author: marioevz
excerpts.content:
Hey, I've checked all the outstanding issues in the [hive results](https://sk3.taile8f668.ts.net/#summary-sort=name&group-by=client) for devnet-6:
- Geth/Besu: Timeout due to RLP block importing, we could workaround by `--client.checktimelimit=120s` - **Not blocking for devnet-6**
- Erigon, Engine API incorrect error when delivering incorrect requests in new payload - **Maybe blocking for devnet-6**
- Nethermind:
  - Potential consensus issue if the EIP-2935 system contract is not deployed at fork - **Blocking for devnet-6 if the system contract is not deployed at fork**
  - Same issue as Erigon: Getting invalid block instead of Engine API error - **Maybe blocking for devnet-6**
- Reth: Consensus issue on EIP-7702 test (gas usage) - **Not blocking for devnet-6**
